question: A cuboid has dimensions 18 m × 12 m × 9 m. What is its total surface area?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total Surface Area (TSA) of a cuboid is simply twice the sum of the products of its dimensions taken two at a time.

TSA = 2 × (lb + bh + hl)

TSA = 2 × (18 × 12 + 12 × 9 + 9 × 18)

TSA = 2 × (216 + 108 + 162) = 2 × 486

TSA = 972

**∴ The correct answer is 972 m².**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**
